Detects redirect loop (A -> B -> A) and stops following without reaching a final page

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import CrawlConfig, crawl, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(respect_robots_txt=False)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await crawl(engine, url)
    print(result.error)
    print(len(result.pages))

asyncio.run(main())
```
